datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2019 across Guatemala administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5 scale) aggregated by geographic area and collection date, with multiple scenario variants captured for each period.
